evals.prompt: Find the smallest built-in role that grants Microsoft.Support/services/read. Explain why your top choice is least privilege.
evals.expected_output: Includes Support Request Contributor in candidate set and ranks by smallest footprint first.

evals.prompt: Find built-in roles that cover both Microsoft.Web/sites/read and Microsoft.Web/sites/write.
evals.expected_output: Returns only roles that satisfy both permissions; read-only roles are excluded.

evals.prompt: Find the smallest built-in role for Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/containers/blobs/read and prefer non-privileged choices.
evals.expected_output: Returns data-reader-capable candidates and keeps privileged roles behind non-privileged roles.

evals.prompt: Find built-in roles that allow Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write and call out risk.
evals.expected_output: Flags matching roles as privileged and warns about role assignment capability.
Returns no matches and recommends considering a custom role.

evals.prompt: Explain whether this skill can determine role scope fit, deny assignments, and PIM settings when ranking roles.
evals.expected_output: Clearly states those checks are out of scope and keeps recommendation bounded to snapshot role matching.
